name: P ZERO Race RS (tube type)

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

manufacturing.basis: Pirelli: the P ZERO Race RS is made in Italy.

positioning: Tube-type version of Pirelli's top P ZERO Race RS.
pressure_note: The product page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Pirelli claims improved grip, especially on wet surfaces.

availability.note: Listed in Pirelli's UK catalogue with a dealer finder; P ZERO tires are sold by retail shops on Taobao and Tmall in mainland China; North American availability not verified.

caveats: Lab results for this exact version were not read.

image.shown: Full view of the P ZERO Race RS tube-type tire from Pirelli's catalogue; one photo covers every width.
image.alt: Pirelli P ZERO Race RS tube-type road tire shown as a full ring

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other. The Classic and Retro editions sold on their own pages count as the same tire.

reports.summary: At least as fast as the GP5000 in real riding, smoother and more confidence-inspiring in corners; no punctures in about 1,000 dry miles.
Grips, rolls and rides well, best with a quality TPU tube.
Clearly more supple and comfortable than the owner's previous P ZERO tires, especially with TPU tubes.
An instant difference in speed and smoothness.
The 30 mm with TPU tubes rides very smoothly and feels fast.
Fitted to climbing wheels in 30 mm; feels good with nothing to complain about.

checks.note: Black and Retro edition pages; the Classic edition page has a star rating only
